recipe.recipe_name: Creamy Tomato Soup with Cheddar Toast and Fried Egg
instructions: Dice the fresh tomatoes. Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat, add the tomatoes, and cook until soft and juicy (about 8 minutes).
Pour in the whole milk and lower the heat to simmer gently for 5 minutes. Stir in half of the cheddar cheese (75g) until fully melted into a creamy soup base, then season with salt and pepper.
Brush the bread slices with remaining olive oil and toast them in a skillet over medium heat. Top with the remaining cheddar cheese, cover the skillet, and let it melt.
In the same skillet, gently fry the eggs until the whites are set but yolks remain soft.
Ladle the creamy tomato soup into bowls, top each with a fried egg, and serve alongside the warm cheddar toast.
recipe.waste_reduction_notes: This recipe prioritizes Whole Milk (expiring 2026-09-22) and Tomatoes (expiring 2026-09-23) to prevent spoilage, while efficiently using available bread, cheddar, and eggs to craft a complete lunch.

recipe.recipe_name: Air Fryer Cheesy Chicken & Tomato Bread Strata
instructions: Dice 1 chicken breast into small bite-sized pieces and toss with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Preheat the air fryer to 380°F (190°C) and cook the diced chicken for 8 minutes until cooked through, then set aside.
Cut the 4 slices of bread into 1-inch cubes and dice the tomatoes.
In a mixing bowl, whisk together 4 eggs and 250 ml of whole milk until well combined.
Grease an air-fryer-safe baking dish or tin with a little olive oil. Layer in the bread cubes, cooked chicken, and diced tomatoes.
Pour the egg and milk mixture evenly over the bread and tomatoes, pressing down gently so the bread absorbs the liquid.
Shred and sprinkle 100g of cheddar cheese evenly over the top.
Place the dish into the air fryer basket and bake at 330°F (165°C) for 18 to 20 minutes, until the custard is set and the cheesy top is golden brown.
Let it rest for 5 minutes before serving hot.

recipe.recipe_name: Chicken, Tomato & Fluffy Egg Rice Stir-Fry
instructions: Rinse 1 cup of rice and cook in boiling salted water for 12-15 minutes until tender, then drain.
While rice is cooking, whisk 3 eggs with 2 tablespoons of whole milk, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.
Cut 2 chicken breasts into bite-sized cubes and dice 2 tomatoes.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken breast cubes and stir-fry for 5 to 7 minutes until fully cooked, then remove and set aside.
Pour the egg and milk mixture into the hot skillet. Soft scramble for 1-2 minutes until gently set, then transfer to the plate with chicken.
Add another tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet and sauté diced tomatoes for 2 minutes until slightly softened.
Add cooked rice, cooked chicken, and scrambled eggs back into the skillet. Stir-fry everything together over high heat for 2 minutes to combine flavors.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, serve hot.
recipe.waste_reduction_notes: This recipe utilizes Whole Milk, Eggs, and Tomatoes, which are among your earliest expiring ingredients (expiring Sept 22-23). Incorporating a splash of milk into the eggs adds fluffiness to the stir-fry while preventing dairy waste.

recipe.recipe_name: Quick Creamy Tomato Cheddar Soup with Toast Croutons
missing_ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Finely dice the fresh tomatoes. Cut the bread slices into small crouton-sized cubes.
Heat olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat. Add the diced tomatoes and sauté for 3-4 minutes until softened and juicy.
Pour in the whole milk and bring to a gentle simmer (do not boil). Lower heat to medium-low.
Shred the cheddar cheese and stir it into the soup until fully melted and creamy.
Whisk the eggs in a small bowl, then slowly drizzle into the simmering soup while gently stirring to create soft ribbons.
In a separate small pan, toast the bread cubes over medium heat for 2-3 minutes until golden and crispy.
Season soup with salt and pepper to taste, ladle into a bowl, and top with crispy toast croutons.

recipe.recipe_name: Savory Cheddar and Tomato French Toast
instructions: Dice the tomatoes and grate or slice the cheddar cheese.
In a wide bowl, whisk together the eggs and whole milk until fully combined.
Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Dip each bread slice into the egg and milk mixture, allowing both sides to absorb the liquid.
Place the dipped bread slices in the pan using your spatula and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until the bottom is golden brown.
Flip the bread slices over, immediately sprinkle the chopped tomatoes and cheddar cheese on top of each slice.
Cover the pan briefly or reduce heat to melt the cheese while the bottom cooks for another 2 to 3 minutes, then serve warm.
recipe.waste_reduction_notes: This recipe prioritizes your soonest-expiring fresh ingredients: Whole Milk (Sept 22), Eggs and Tomatoes (Sept 23), Cheddar Cheese (Sept 24), and Bread (Sept 25), effectively using them up before they spoil while adhering to your 15-minute cooking window.
